module: Flowgraph node "Is Walking Blacklisted" (category repeat_instant, depends on gameplay_walk). Indicates whether a vehicle (vehId pin) is allowed or forbidden for entry from walking mode. Outputs: allowed, denied (flow) and value (hidden bool).
notes: Bug: work writes self.pinOut.bool.value, but no "bool" pin exists (the pin is called value): the access crashes as soon as vehId is set.

work.desc: Calls gameplay_walk.isVehicleBlacklisted(vehId) to fill allowed/denied; sets the outputs to nil if vehId is absent.
